root_cause.text: The driver uses `WARN_ON(1)` as a placeholder for an unimplemented command (`NPU_OP_RESIZE`) that can be triggered by unprivileged userspace via the `DRM_IOCTL_ETHOSU_GEM_CREATE` ioctl, causing unbounded kernel log spam and potential kernel panic when `panic_on_warn` is set, enabling a trivial denial-of-service.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff changes the `case NPU_OP_RESIZE` from `WARN_ON(1); break;` to `return -EINVAL;`. The commit message explicitly states that the `WARN_ON(1)` placeholder "fires unconditionally whenever userspace submits this command ... causing unbounded kernel log spam" and that "if panic_on_warn is set the kernel panics, giving any unprivileged user ... a trivial denial-of-service primitive."
